prompt: our marketing team keeps saying conversion is 'flat' this quarter and nothing to worry about. gut says something's off - we've been spending more on paid and organic traffic is up. data is funnel_monthly.csv (jan-jun 2026) with visits, signups, conversions by channel and user_type (new vs returning). please build me a jupyter notebook i can share with the growth team so they can re-run it. tell me whether conversion is actually flat and what's happening underneath.
assertions: A valid Jupyter notebook file (analysis.ipynb) exists as the final deliverable
Notebook correctly confirms that aggregate conversion is roughly flat
Notebook surfaces that new-user conversion improved substantially
Notebook surfaces that returning-user conversion regressed
Notebook explicitly names Simpson's Paradox OR composition shift
At least 2 chart titles are action-oriented
Recommendations are included with owners and confidence grades
